title: Matangi Rubber IPO
summary: Matangi Rubber IPO is a ₹125.16 crore book-built issue priced at ₹163–₹172 per share, to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO opens on December 1, 2026 and closes on December 3, 2026, with allotment expected on December 4 and listing on December 8, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹14,964 for 87 shares.

Matangi Rubber financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Incorporated in June 2004, Matangi Rubber Limited deals in manufacturing of tyres, tyre flaps, tyre tubes, and rubber compounds for automotive and industrial use. The company mainly serves the 2-wheeler, 3-wheeler, and commercial vehicles market sectors through manufacturing, contract manufacturing, and job work activities. · Matangi Rubber has 7 manufacturing units in Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu, which include manufacturing units owned by its subsidiary, MG Industries Limited. The units produce tyre flaps, tyre tubes, rubber compounds, and tyres for several automotive uses. · The business strategy of the company involves manufacturing & selling, contract manufacturing, and job work based on conversion for tyre companies. The company also does some trading in rubber products and provides certain support services to some of its major customers like JK Tyre & Industries Limited. · As on May 31, 2025, the company had 240 employees.
Mohit Gupta, Manju Gupta, Radhika Gupta, Vandana Rubber & Chemicals Pvt.Ltd. are the company's promoters of Matangi Rubber.
